paragraphs.text: A loose [Yunnan white](yunnan-white:definition) from 2018, picked from wild bush trees that grow in mixed forest rather than in managed gardens. Those trees give larger leaves, so this leaf was withered a little longer before drying. Nothing more was done to it: as with all [white tea](white:definition), the leaf was never heated to stop its change and never rolled.

It is eight years old. Yunnan white is [kept like Fujian white](yunnan-white:ageing), and some keep it for years, but there is no agreed view of how long it should age or how it compares with aged Fujian white. Some drinkers prefer it within its first few years.

brewing.text: Yunnan white is brewed gently, as a white tea is, in a gaiwan or small pot, and it gives many infusions; the leaf holds up well.

notice.text: A honeyed, sweet cup, often richer and fuller than Fujian white, with little bitterness, sometimes fruit like apricot or melon and a hay or herbal note. Yabao is sweet and silky, often with pine or herbal notes.
